# Drug Tracker

> Personal medication tracking and simulations. Results are not medical advice or measured drug levels.

## Public information

- [Simulator](https://treeezh.com/drug/)
- [Privacy and encryption limits](https://treeezh.com/drug/privacy.html)
- [Terms of use](https://treeezh.com/drug/terms.html)
- [Source and security information](https://github.com/Treeezheng/drug-tracker)

Account records and authentication endpoints are private. This file does not grant access to them or authorize sharing any user data.
